_comment: MSEDCL LT residential tariff config for the Citizen Escalation Engine calc engine. Overcharge from slab-jump lumping is computed on `energyCharge` ONLY (wheeling is flat across slabs, so it is not distorted). Source of truth: MERC Order Case No. 75 of 2025 (final 25 Mar 2026), frozen at Architecture/Verification sources/MERC-MSEDCL-Tariff-Order-Case-75-of-2025.pdf. See tariff-config-notes.md for the design decisions (grilling 2026-09-01).
source: MERC Order Case No. 75 of 2025 (final 25 Mar 2026); revised MYT after SC-directed fresh review
coverageNote: Periods before 2025-07-01 fall under the prior FY2024-25 order (not loaded). Flag such portions as 'outside verified tariff data', do not guess.
straddleRule: For a consumption period crossing an effectiveFrom boundary, apply the version in force for each equivalent month the pro-rata calc spans (per-month tariff), not a single bill-date tariff.
rounding: Match MSEDCL bill rounding (nearest rupee); cross-check against a real bill before shipping.

versions.label: FY2025-26
versions.note: OCR-garbled in the order's two-panel (existing-vs-approved) table. Fixed 130, wheeling ~1.47. Totals appear to be ~5.74 / 12.57 / 16.85 / 19.15 but the energy-charge split is UNVERIFIED. RE-TRANSCRIBE from the MSEDCL tariff booklet or a real 2025-26 bill before any calc uses this window.

unsupportedCategories.LT-I-A-BPL: Flat Rs 1.48/unit, no slabs (FY2026-27); slab-jump math does not apply. Tool must say 'this tariff isn't supported yet'.
